_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, serving approximately 70 million Americans.' 'We must effectively manage our health care costs.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based products comprise approximately 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, serving approximately 70 million Americans.' 'We must effectively manage our health care costs.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based products comprise approximately 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.10x; -13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.06; conservative 2yr +87%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY97-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.2%/yr (FY08 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +28.6%/yr (FY97-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +38.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY97-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2008-02-08) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.10x (-19.7% downside to Bear $57.71 / +201.7% upside to Bull $145.42) | Adj composite 2.17 vs market 1.11: gap +1.06 [UNDERVALUED] | -13% above the EPP floor $55.65 (14x FY08E $3.98) | Conservative 2-yr case: +86.8% total (+43.4%/yr) | At 12.1x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $63.74 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +3.2% YoY in Q4 2007, forward revenues +10% (FY08 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
